text:
maria_cs: Heads up 1: Kyoto Labs blew past APAC demo limits. They asked for a temporary QPS bump + IP allowlist for demo nodes (52.78.16.0/24). Renewal discussion in 6 weeks, want it to go smoothly. Can ops assist?
sam_ops: On it. Which APAC region?
ivan_net: They prefer tokyo (ap-northeast-1). Provided two egress IPs: 52.78.16.12 and 52.78.16.13 1. Want those whitelisted specifically.
maria_cs: Customer message: "demo traffic spike, 300-400 rps sustained; please lift soft limit to 2500 qps for duration."
sam_ops: Proposed plan: soft QPS=2500, hard QPS=3500, autorevoke after 72h, 24h pre-revoke notice. Need eng-infra approval for region-pin + allowlist.
ivan_net: Minimal checklist for eng-infra: 1) add CIDR 52.78.16.0/24 to tenant allowlist 2) bump soft qps to 2500 for tenant kyoto-labs 3) schedule autorevoke @72h 4) validate egress IPs work via healthcheck.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: draft change scheduled: 2025-04-05T08:00:00Z 1 1 status: pending-approval. Change summary: add CIDR 52.78.16.0/24, tenant soft qps=2500, hard=3500, autorevoke=72h.
sam_ops: Created ENGOPS-4821 and pinged @eng-infra. Patch: "kyoto-labs: ap-northeast-1 allowlist + temp qps bump". Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/ENGOPS-4821
maria_cs: Customer also requested a short post-demo cost estimate and 24h notice before revoke. Can someone tag finance?
finance-bot: finance-bot: noted. Will prepare token-cost snapshot post-demo and send to maria_cs.
ivan_net: Test curl to validate allowlist when live:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Forwarded-For: 52.78.16.12" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/healthcheck
```
Expected: 200
sam_ops: I'll run the healthcheck after deploy and paste results. Rollback criteria: latency > 500ms OR error rate > 2% -> revert limits and notify CS + customer.
julie_am: Looping in renewals and sales-ops; flagging as potential renewal risk if demo fails. I'll capture feedback post-demo and add notes to renewal playbook for Kyoto Labs.
maria_cs: Thanks all. Please post status updates here and ping if approvals block the window. :thumbsup:
